backend.build_provenance: Release binary pinned by hash; thermodynamic C build commit is not independently established.

host_ledger.amount_basis: mol of named MELTS endmember; mol of molecular dissolved H2
host_ledger.standard_convention: full MELTS potentials at T/P; absolute dissolved H2 standard supplied separately
host_ledger.mathematical_domain: positive host total, nonnegative H2; provider must accept the supplied composition
host_ledger.calibration_domain: not established for the coupled reduced host/alloy/gas model
host_ledger.stable_phase_evidence: not supplied by a liquid property callback
host_ledger.extrapolation_policy: conditional mechanism only until common standards and competing phases are validated

standards.policy: Fixed source branch extrapolation; common R conversion, native alloy shifts, and one H2 solubility pressure term. Cross-phase alignment is unverified.

common_gas.reaction_model: Packaged FastChem4 M1 gas; continuous temperature evaluation
common_gas.policy: Keep existing lower anchor energies, adopt common gas reactions; no cross-phase calibration.

missing_acceptance: alloy H interactions and pressure response
BSE liquid stability and omitted transfer bounds

atmosphere.amount_basis: Seven finite atomic amounts, internally minimized into gas plus retained cloud.
atmosphere.retention: Full retention; atmospheric Fe condensate is distinct from the deep alloy.
atmosphere.pressure: Gas partial pressures sum to total pressure; clouds add mass without gas pressure.

contact.scope: Shared partial pressures only; standards, additional species and condensates need separate audits.

gas_contact.scope: Shared partial pressures only; standards, additional species and condensates need separate audits.

expanded_contact.scope: Local retained-atmosphere contact; material calibration and global planetary closure remain separate.

interpretation: All 35 gases and 26 retained condensates participate in the finite source and contact audits.
